title_en: Call for Participants: KARI-Hosted Super-Gap Company Recruitment Session (Let's Co., Ltd.)
summary: The department has posted a call for participants in a recruitment information session for super-gap (cutting-edge) companies, hosted by the Korea Aerospace Research Institute (KARI), featuring Let's Co., Ltd. (주식회사 렛츠). The notice text gives no eligibility, date, venue or application method. These details may be in the attached poster image, which was not read, so interested students should open the poster or contact the department office, whose contact details are in the original notice.
steps: Open the attached poster image (채용설명회 포스터.png) on the original notice to find the session date, venue, eligibility and application method; its content was not read for this translation.
If anything is unclear, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
